evidence.title: Viggle | Turn your imagination into 3D motion

name: Viggle
summary: Moves characters with AI: motion capture, image-to-video animation and character swaps.
description: Pick a character and a motion from a library of about 8,000 templates to get a video, or use PINOC for 3D character animation from ordinary footage with FBX and GLB export and an MCP server for agents. Also image-to-video, text-to-video, dance, face swap and lip sync, plus Viggle Games and a REST API billed per second.
contains: apps: Meme Maker, PINOC, Viggle Games, Viggle API
about 8,000 motion templates in the motion library
PINOC: 3D character animation with FBX or GLB export and an MCP server with 10 tools
Pro $7.99 and Max $63.99 per month with 80 to 800 credits
